note: Reflects final canonical main for M0-M4. Updated at every milestone merge. A capability is QUALIFIED only after a passing real-host qualification record exists for the merged code; SUPPORTED means implemented and gate-tested without a real-host record; nothing is listed that is not merged.

capabilities.name: Local administrator authentication
capabilities.limitation: one administrator; no multi-user, no external identity provider

capabilities.name: Host readiness and capability check
capabilities.limitation: a configuration check, not a host qualification; matrix verdicts for other distributions are not Development Preview support

capabilities.name: Create VM from a qualified Ubuntu image with one SSH key, and Start
capabilities.limitation: Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image; one qualification host class

capabilities.name: Serial boot output and interactive serial console
capabilities.limitation: text console; early boot lines may be missing; graphical console and rescue mode are not offered; the interactive console is off unless the operator enables it

capabilities.name: Stop, Reboot, Force off, Delete
capabilities.limitation: Delete only for a Stopped VM; no live operations

capabilities.name: Images, storage, resize, reinstall, snapshots, backup, restore (M2)
capabilities.limitation: local-only backup; internal snapshots only; images imported by the host administrator; one qualification host class

capabilities.name: Managed NAT networks, IP assignment, compute resize, profiles (M3)
capabilities.limitation: NAT with one NIC only; a DHCP reservation does not re-address a VM that already holds an active lease; it governs a later allocation

capabilities.name: Installer, systemd deployment, upgrade, rollback, diagnostics, uninstall (M4)
capabilities.limitation: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS x86_64 only; unsigned local release build; old-configuration migration is limited; host-reboot qualification remains an open item

capabilities.name: Host bridge for VMs on the host's own network (wave 2)
capabilities.limitation: netplan with networkd and one static IPv4 Ethernet uplink only; applied in nested guests, not on the qualification host; Svavyom does not know the addresses of VMs on a bridge network

capabilities.name: Public API, automation, billing, reseller, enterprise tenancy (M5/M6)
